purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of USGS Work Unit Extent Spatial Metadata (WESM) source original identity and quality-lineage discovery distinct from the seamless one-meter S1M raster.

entries.name: USGS 3DEP Work Unit Extent Spatial Metadata (WESM) CSV and GeoPackage
entries.spatial_scope: USGS published 3DEP work units; not an S1M tile-to-source spatial join and not guaranteed universal one-meter lidar coverage.
entries.temporal_scope: WESM source is reissued nearly daily; collection dates, original snapshot retrieval UTC, exact source byte hashes and separate GeoPackage geometry are mandatory for reproducibility.
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Work unit source metadata and status categories, not individual S1M elevation raster pixels.
entries.note: Official USGS WESM source CSV and GeoPackage are published on rockyweb.usgs.gov. The CSV is a non-spatial workunit table; complete source provenance and link to exact Florida S1M tile require a separately verified GeoPackage polygon spatial join. One bounded 32KiB original CSV header may later be reviewed/verified through its own access contract. This discovery record grants no full CSV, no original GeoPackage, no byte redistribution or CAT-model admission.
